=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
text d1 "-7 1 5 2 -4 3 0"
text d2 "2 4 6"
text d3 "2 9 2"
text d4 "1 -1 1 -1 1 -1 1"
text tidx "equilibrium indices:"
global vals long 16
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emiti writes a signed n; the magnitude is taken as a ulong so the minimum long cannot overflow
fn emiti n long to void
if lt n 0
emit minus
emitu add bitcast ulong not n 1
else
emitu ulong n
end
end
note parse reads the decimal numbers in s (separated by spaces, an optional - sign) into vals and
note returns how many; one pass over s, so the loop is bounded by len s
fn parse s view uchar * to ulong
n = ulong 0
v = long 0
sg = long 1
dig = false
for i ulong len s
c = get s i
if eq c 45
sg = long -1
else
if and ge c 48 le c 57
v = add mul v 10 long sub c 48
dig = true
else
if dig
put vals n mul sg v
n = add n 1
end
v = long 0
sg = long 1
dig = false
end
end
end
if dig
put vals n mul sg v
n = add n 1
end
ret n
end
note show writes vals[0..n-1] separated by spaces, then a newline
fn show n ulong to void
for i ulong n
if gt i 0
emit sp
end
emiti get vals i
end
emit nl
end
note eqidx keeps the sum to the left and the sum to the right of i in one pass after the total
fn eqidx n ulong to void
tot = long 0
for i ulong n
tot = add tot get vals i
end
lsum = long 0
emit tidx
for i ulong n
rsum = sub sub tot lsum get vals i
if eq lsum rsum
emit sp
emitu i
end
lsum = add lsum get vals i
end
emit nl
end
fn main to int
n = parse d1
show n
eqidx n
n = parse d2
show n
eqidx n
n = parse d3
show n
eqidx n
n = parse d4
show n
eqidx n
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
-7 1 5 2 -4 3 0
equilibrium indices: 3 6
2 4 6
equilibrium indices:
2 9 2
equilibrium indices: 1
1 -1 1 -1 1 -1 1
equilibrium indices: 0 1 2 3 4 5 6
</pre>
